summary.text: Patricia Puertas Rucker is a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate from District 16, listed with Jefferson County; the district covers Jefferson and part of Berkeley counties. Her legislative page lists her as Assistant Majority Leader and chair of the Select Committee on School Choice.

paragraphs.text: Rucker's page lists a B.A. in history from Trinity College in Washington, D.C., and her occupation as home schooling mother.
It gives her birthplace as Caracas, Venezuela, names her spouse as James M. Rucker Jr., and lists five children.

Her affiliations include the Farm Bureau, the Eastern Panhandle Business Association, 4-H and WV4Life-Jefferson County; the page also lists an Iron Lady Award from the American Legislative Exchange Council, a Champion of Free Enterprise award from the WV Chamber of Commerce, a role on the executive committees of Women in Government and the American Legislative Exchange Council, and her role as co-founder and former president of We the People of West Virginia-Jefferson County.

Rucker also serves on the Senate's Agriculture, Government Organization, Health and Human Resources, Judiciary, Rules and Transportation and Infrastructure committees, and between sessions she chairs the Rule-Making Review Committee.
